scope: ONE saved51case replay with new provider-chain resolver; no new experiment requests, outcome changes or statistical formula changes.
replayCommand: nice -n19 uv run --no-sync python thesis/analysis/k1_saved_case_history.py --requester-custody thesis/evidence/orca-relayed-http-v1197 --requester-snapshot thesis/evidence/orca-relayed-http-v1197/analysis-v1240/REQUESTER-CURRENT.snapshot.json --provider-extracted thesis/evidence/orca-relayed-http-v1197/provider-transfer-delta-v1261/extracted --provider-coverage-chain thesis/evidence/orca-relayed-http-v1197/provider-transfer-delta-v1261/COVERAGE-CHAIN.json --output-dir <fresh-versioned-directory-under-thesis>
